title: Hunger, Thirst and Sexual Response
summary: Physiological mechanisms; lipostatic and glucostatic theories of hunger; osmotic and hypovolemic thirst; sexual response cycle.
objectives: Compare lipostatic and glucostatic hunger theories.
Describe the sexual response cycle phases.
revision: Hunger: lipostatic (fat/leptin) vs glucostatic (glucose). Thirst: osmotic (solute concentration) vs hypovolemic (blood volume). Sexual response: excitement → plateau → orgasm → resolution.
traps: Osmotic thirst = increased blood solute concentration.

r: Body fat level regulates hunger via leptin

notes.t: The sexual response cycle includes excitement, plateau, orgasm and resolution phases, with physiological changes in each phase.
UGC NET frequently tests lipostatic vs glucostatic hunger theories and osmotic vs hypovolemic thirst distinctions.
